# Aung Zaw Win

> Businessman, politician and member of Parliament

- Known for: Businessman, politician and member of Parliament
- Fields: Politics, Business
- Page: https://people.rohingya.ro/people/aung-zaw-win/

## Summary

A Rohingya businessman and politician who represented Maungdaw in Myanmar's Union Parliament, elected in the 2010 general election and serving in the Upper House during the 2011–2016 parliamentary period. In September 2011 he raised a parliamentary question on the issuing of national registration cards to Maungdaw residents.

## What he did

- **2010** — Elected in the general election as an Upper House representative for Maungdaw, serving in the Union Parliament from 2011 to 2016.
- **2011** — In September, raised a question in Parliament about issuing national registration cards to Maungdaw residents.
- **In office** — Met local residents in Maungdaw to discuss development and identification issues.

## Biography: Raising Maungdaw's questions in Parliament

Aung Zaw Win is a Rohingya businessman and politician who served as a member of Myanmar's Parliament representing Maungdaw. He was elected during the 2010 general election and served in the Union Parliament during the 2011–2016 parliamentary period. Contemporary reporting identifies him as an Upper House representative from Maungdaw.

During his parliamentary period, Aung Zaw Win raised issues concerning Maungdaw residents. Parliamentary records cited in academic research show that he raised a question concerning the issuance of national registration cards to Maungdaw residents in September 2011. He also met local residents in Maungdaw and discussed development and identification issues.
